title: First Green Gigawatts (2027)
description: Start at milestone 3, four days into its window: build 20+ GW of renewables and commit the North Sea hub program — HVDC unlocks mid-window in 2028 — while the scripted congestion day tests your corridors and zero UFLS is the bar.

economy._rationale: C3 fixture: sized for the reference ★-tier build program (~10 GW onshore wind + ~5 GW solar + 3 GW offshore + a platform + batteries + spur corridors ≈ 30 B€ capex) with operating headroom; the arc's balancing pass may trim it.

_why_start_day: Day 28 sits four days inside milestone 3's window [24,48] — battery and no-longer-locked kinds are 2027-open, the HVDC/platform unlock (2028 = day 36) flips MID-RUN, which is exactly what the smoke must prove end to end (C1's year_changed enforcement live). Day 28 is 00:00 on a representative day, and ledger 53's now-anchored startup profile makes the cold start balanced.
